jahdoo.message.villager_smith: I deal in keys and relics born of flame. If it was shaped in fire, you'll find it here
jahdoo.message.villager_perk: I brew Perka Sodas—potent elixirs with a pop. Each can fizzes with magical might.
jahdoo.message.villager_unique: You won’t find these in any guild shop. Enchanted, forbidden, and worth every coin—if you can afford the price.
info.jahdoo.ticket.teleport: Teleports you to the Trial Nexus
description.item.jahdoo.starter_pack: Starter Packs are tiered bundles that provide everything needed to begin your journey. Each pack includes a full armor set, a sword, and a basic wand. Available tiers include Iron, Diamond, and Netherite.
description.item.jahdoo.magent: Magnets pull nearby items toward the player from a distance. Range determines how far items can be attracted, while strength controls how quickly they are pulled in.
description.item.jahdoo.skill_point: Skill Points increase a player’s overall available skill points without requiring them to level up.
description.item.jahdoo.recovery_receipt: The Recovery Receipt preserves all of your items when you die in the Nexus. Recovering your items requires a cost that increases with difficulty. Hold right-click while holding the receipt to retrieve your items
description.item.jahdoo.elemental_wands: Elemental Wands are caster items that allow players to cast spells. They are especially powerful because they enhance spells of their respective type, applying beneficial bonuses. As wand rarity increases, these bonuses grow stronger and expand beyond raw damage, also improving factors such as cooldowns and mana efficiency.
description.item.jahdoo.shields: Shields are passive items that have a chance to block incoming damage without needing to be actively used. While equipped in their slot, they mitigate damage based on a percentage chance, allowing them to block attacks automatically.
description.item.jahdoo.rune: Runes are powerful items that can be placed into rune slots found on various pieces of gear. When equipped or actively used, runes significantly enhance magic and damage capabilities, with effects varying based on the rune type.
description.item.jahdoo.seal_of_extensio: The Seal of Extension is an item seal that can be applied to gear to increase its potential.
description.item.jahdoo.seal_of_repair: The Seal of Repair restores a broken repair slot, allowing an item’s usable lifespan to be extended.
description.item.jahdoo.seal_of_power: The Seal of Power allows gear to gain an additional rune slot, up to a maximum of 10 rune slots per item.
description.item.jahdoo.seal_of_defence: The Seal of Defence increases the maximum durability of any gear.
description.item.jahdoo.overenchanted_bo: Overenchanted Books grant access to significantly more powerful enchantments, allowing certain enchantments to reach levels up to 10. These enhanced effects far exceed those of standard enchanted books.
description.item.jahdoo.dim_xp_orb: The Dim XP Orb grants experience when right-clicked. This variant provides 20 experience points.
description.item.jahdoo.glowing_xp_orb: The Glowing XP Orb grants experience when right-clicked. This variant provides 120 experience points.
description.item.jahdoo.radiant_xp_orb: Radiant XP Orb grants experience when right-clicked. This variant provides 1200 experience points.
description.item.jahdoo.pocket_dimension: The Pocket Dimension is a player’s personal safe haven. Using the bottle teleports you back and forth between your Pocket Dimension and the origin dimension.
description.item.jahdoo.challenger_soul: The Challenger Soul is a rare crafting item with a chance to drop from Challengers within the Nexus.
description.item.jahdoo.stamp: Stamps can be applied to Trial Tickets at the Ticket Bureau. Each stamp adds a positive modifier, increasing the amount the ticket must be filled before use. Most tickets naturally come with a high chance of having a negative modifier.
description.item.jahdoo.battlemage_gaunt: The Battlemage Gauntlet is an arcane relic that allows wands to be wielded in the offhand, freeing the main hand for another weapon or tool while maintaining magical control.
description.item.jahdoo.tome_of_unity: The Tome of Unity is an ancient mana-bound relic that deepens your connection to arcane forces, increasing both your maximum mana and mana regeneration.
description.item.jahdoo.exit_key: The Exit Key can be used on a locked door in the Nexus to convert it into an exit. This allows you to escape the Nexus at any time instead of waiting for a Sanctum
description.item.jahdoo.bazaar_key: The Bazaar Key can be used on a locked door in the Nexus to convert it into a Bazaar. This allows you to purchase items at any time instead of waiting for a Sanctum.
description.item.jahdoo.sanctuary_key: The Sanctuary Key can be used on a locked door in the Nexus to convert it into a Sanctuary. This allows you to replenish your mana and health at any time instead of waiting for a Sanctum.
description.item.jahdoo.crypt_key: The Crypt  Key can be used on a locked door in the Nexus to convert it into a Crypt. This allows you to Loot locked chest and raid open chests at any time instead of waiting for a Sanctum.
description.item.jahdoo.challenger_key: The Challenger Key can be used on a locked door in the Nexus to convert it into a Challenger room. This allows you to fight Challengers at any time during your run.
description.item.jahdoo.dice: Modifier Re-Roll Dice can be right-clicked on a locked door in the Nexus dimension. Using it on the lock rerolls the door’s modifiers, giving you a chance for different effects.
description.item.jahdoo.trial_ticket: Trial Tickets are the entry point to the Trial Nexus. Tickets must be filled at a Ticket Bureau before use. Once filled, they can be used to transport you by holding right-click until the timer completes. Tickets come in multiple tiers, allowing them to be reused a limited number of times, while standard tickets can only be used once. Reusable tickets become especially valuable when combined with modifiers. Rare tickets cannot be crafted and are only found in loot chests.
description.item.jahdoo.cores: Cores come in two variants: Charged and Hollow. Charged Cores are powerful items used for tasks ranging from repairing gear to serving as crafting ingredients. Hollow Cores are inert until charged. They can be powered in the Nexus by placing them in altars, where nearby slain mobs provide the energy needed to fill them. Higher-tier cores require more kills to fully charge.
description.item.jahdoo.salamans_eye: Salman’s Eye is a powerful relic once held by the Protectors of the Nexus. When placed in your Protector Curio slot, it increases your available Relic slots.
description.block.jahdoo.tank: A storage tank for Nexite Powder that acts as a central power source for nearby machinery. It can be automated, does not require binding, and supplies all compatible blocks within a 5×5 area.
description.block.jahdoo.ticket_bureau: The Ticket Bureau is a specialized station used to fill tickets, enabling transport to the Nexus. It also allows stamp modifiers to be applied, altering how tickets behave. Hold Shift while looking at the block to view detailed ticket information.
description.block.jahdoo.modular_chaos_c: The Modular Chaos Cube is a powerful automation block capable of casting utility spells on behalf of the player. It harnesses Nexite Powder through a Nexite Tank instead of using mana. The block features a GUI that allows control over spell direction, inputs and outputs, and casting intervals. It can also cast spells in response to a redstone signal rather than relying on its internal timing.
description.block.jahdoo.disassembler: The Disassembler acts as a recycling station for unwanted or discarded gear. Recycling items requires power from a Nexite Tank, but in return it can yield useful materials. Higher-rarity gear can yield better materials.
description.block.jahdoo.rune_table: The Divine Forge serves as a modification station for gear and weapons. It allows you to repair equipment, add or remove runes from slots, and perform additional upgrades.
description.block.jahdoo.mystical_augmen: The Mystical Augmenter is an incredibly powerful block with many unique properties. When attached to other blocks, it enhances their functionality, including converting a composter’s output from bonemeal into Nexite Powder.
description.block.jahdoo.creator: The Creator Pedestal enables the creation of mystical items and operations not usually possible. This includes fusing Over-Enchanted books onto compatible items.
description.ability.jahdoo.test: This is just a test for testing
